cues: These nouns are uncountable in English, even though in Nepali they can be counted: information, advice, news, furniture, luggage, equipment, stationery, scenery, knowledge, homework, research, progress, evidence, traffic, money, bread, hair, jewellery, permission and damage.
So: no s, no a or an, a singular verb, and much or a little rather than many or a few.
